title: URN wagon and feature segments are the plan's exact kebab-case identifiers

facts.note: Bun stack sources; the detector is Bun-specific.

Needs an observer that parses the source traceability header and finds a well-formed six-segment URN. Applies to existing headers as well as newly written or edited ones; no diff or phase precondition.

One activation route only: emitted by bun_green_traceability_detector when segment 1 or 2 fails the kebab pattern. Not a prerequisite — the rule also applies when the segments pass the regex but differ from the plan's canonical identifiers.

values: plan wagon/feature identity of the URN
facts.note: Whether wagon/feature equal the plan's canonical identifiers for the code's owning feature needs a plan lookup; judged by an LLM/reviewer until a plan-join observer exists.

fires: A Bun source file has a well-formed six-segment URN header (new or pre-existing) whose wagon segment has uppercase letters (e.g. `Orders`).
A URN header's feature segment uses underscores, camelCase or a leading digit instead of lowercase kebab-case.
A URN header's wagon/feature match the regex but are not the plan's identifiers for the feature that owns the code (e.g. copied from a neighboring feature).
The detector reports GREEN-URN-003 naming the wagon or feature segment.
doesNotFire: The URN does not have six well-formed segments (handled by coder.bun.green-urn-pattern).
Only the name, side or layer segment is malformed; wagon and feature already match the plan's kebab identifiers.
A file with no URN header.

given: A Bun source file carries a well-formed six-segment URN header (new or existing)
when: the file is written, edited or checked
then: The `{wagon}` and `{feature}` segments MUST be the plan's exact identifiers and match `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`.
prefer: During GREEN: derive both values from the feature currently being implemented.
During GREEN: if the identity is already correct, normalize only casing or separators.
avoid: Touching the name, side or layer segments while fixing wagon/feature.
Inventing or renaming plan wagons/features to satisfy the header.
Copying identifiers from a neighboring feature without checking ownership.
unless: URNs that are not six well-formed segments (owned by green-urn-pattern).
Name, side and layer segments (own rules).
why: Wagon and feature are case- and separator-sensitive join keys into `plan/`: `Orders` and `orders` differ to a string match, so a wrong header binds to nothing while reading correctly to a human (silent join failure). Kebab-case is the plan's own grammar.
evidence: bun_green_traceability_detector reports no wagon/feature finding for the file.
Wagon and feature segments match the plan's canonical identifiers.
The current behavioral acceptance passes (see policy.phase-loop).
verifier_detail: Term kebab_identifier: pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`, the plan's own grammar for wagon and feature names; applied to segments 1 (wagon) and 2 (feature) of a well-formed six-segment URN; the finding names whichever segment(s) fail.
Skip URNs that are not six well-formed segments; those are reported by coder.bun.green-urn-pattern.
Do not evaluate name, side or layer segments here; they are governed by their own rules.
Severity 3; disposition strict (generic meaning in policy.strict-disposition), enforced locally by bun_green_traceability_detector.

Term silent_join_failure: the state where a header reads correctly to a human but binds to nothing because a case- or separator-sensitive key did not match. Flag headers whose segments differ from the plan key only in case or separators.
A regex pass is not sufficient: canonical identity (segments equal the plan's identifiers for the owning feature) must also hold.
